mapper.sql: id, username, display_name, email, email_verified, password_hash, timezone, last_login_at, profile_picture_url, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_user WHERE username != '__connex_system__'

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.display_name, u.email, u.password_hash, u.timezone, u.last_login_at, u.profile_picture_url, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM app_user u JOIN workspace_member wm ON wm.user_id = u.id AND wm.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} WHERE u.username LIKE #{query} OR u.display_name LIKE #{query} OR u.email LIKE #{query} ORDER BY u.username LIMIT 10
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_user (username, display_name, email, email_verified, password_hash, timezone, profile_picture_url) VALUES (#{username}, #{displayName}, #{email}, #{emailVerified}, #{passwordHash}, COALESCE(#{timezone}, 'UTC'), #{profilePictureUrl})
